---
name: Release
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      validation_only:
        description: Validate the exact candidate without any publication action.
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION: "2026-03-10"
jobs:
  deterministic:
    name: Complete deterministic CI
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/podman-lens'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci.yml
    with:
      api_purpose: published
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      statuses: read
  release-metadata:
    name: Release metadata
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/podman-lens'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.candidate_sha }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive and validate release metadata
        id: metadata
        shell: bash
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          [[ "${GITHUB_REF}" == "refs/heads/${DEFAULT_BRANCH}" ]] || {
            echo "Run releases from the default branch (${DEFAULT_BRANCH})." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          bash scripts/check-release-metadata.sh --release
          version="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -er '.packages[] | select(.name == "podman-lens") | .version')"
          notes="${RUNNER_TEMP}/podman-lens-release-notes-${version}.md"
          bash scripts/extract-release-notes.sh "${version}" > "${notes}"
          {
            printf 'version=%s\n' "${version}"
            printf 'tag=v%s\n' "${version}"
            printf 'notes=%s\n' "${notes}"
            printf 'candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  native-conformance:
    name: Native API conformance
    if: github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/podman-lens'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/native-podman-conformance.yml
    with:
      release_validation: true
    permissions:
      contents: read
  semver:
    name: SemVer
    needs: deterministic
    if: needs.deterministic.result == 'success'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-semver.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      package: podman-lens
      api_purpose: published
      initial_api_contract: true
  release-gate:
    name: Release validation gate
    needs: [deterministic, native-conformance, semver]
    if: needs.native-conformance.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Download current-run native evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: podman-lens-native-api-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}-podman-6.1-*
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/native-evidence
          merge-multiple: false
      - name: Validate complete current-run native evidence
        shell: bash
        run:
          bash scripts/validate-native-evidence.sh "${RUNNER_TEMP}/native-evidence" "${GITHUB_SHA}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
      - name: Require exact-candidate published API evidence
        shell: bash
        env:
          DETERMINISTIC_PUBLISHED_API_SHA: ${{ needs.deterministic.outputs.deterministic_published_api_candidate_sha }}
          SEMVER_PUBLISHED_API_SHA: ${{ needs.semver.outputs.published_api_candidate_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${DETERMINISTIC_PUBLISHED_API_SHA}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          test "${SEMVER_PUBLISHED_API_SHA}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
      - name: Expose verified current-run native evidence candidate binding
        id: binding
        run: printf 'candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ steps.binding.outputs.candidate_sha }}
  publish:
    name: Publish PodmanLens
    needs: [shared-release-gate, release-preparation]
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/podman-lens' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) &&
      inputs.validation_only != true && needs.shared-release-gate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.shared-release-gate.outputs.candidate_sha == github.sha &&
      needs.release-preparation.result == 'success'
    environment: release
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      artifact-metadata: write
      attestations: write
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Check out protected exact release source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive release metadata
        id: metadata
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          version="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -er '.packages[] | select(.name == "podman-lens") | .version')"
          notes="${RUNNER_TEMP}/podman-lens-release-notes-${version}.md"
          bash scripts/extract-release-notes.sh "${version}" > "${notes}"
          {
            printf 'version=%s\n' "${version}"
            printf 'tag=v%s\n' "${version}"
            printf 'notes=%s\n' "${notes}"
            printf 'crate=target/package/podman-lens-%s.crate\n' "${version}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Build release package and checksum
        env:
          CRATE: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.crate }}
        run: |
          cargo ci-package
          sha256sum "${CRATE}" > "${CRATE}.sha256"
      - name: Attest release package
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.crate }}
      - name: Create or verify annotated release tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          if git ls-remote --exit-code origin "refs/tags/${TAG}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            git fetch --force origin "refs/tags/${TAG}:refs/tags/${TAG}"
            [[ "$(git rev-list -n 1 "${TAG}")" == "${GITHUB_SHA}" ]]
          else
            tag_object_sha="$(gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags" --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" -f tag="${TAG}" -f message="PodmanLens ${TAG}" -f object="${GITHUB_SHA}" -f type=commit --jq '.sha')"
            gh api --method POST "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/refs" --header "X-GitHub-Api-Version: ${RELEASE_GITHUB_API_VERSION}" -f ref="refs/tags/${TAG}" -f sha="${tag_object_sha}"
          fi
      - name: Create or replace draft GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NOTES: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.notes }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          if ! gh release view "${TAG}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release create "${TAG}" --draft --title "PodmanLens ${VERSION}" --notes-file "${NOTES}"
          fi
      - name: Upload draft GitHub release assets
        env:
          CRATE: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.crate }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.tag }}
        run: gh release upload "${TAG}" --clobber "${CRATE}" "${CRATE}.sha256"
      - name: Publish exact approved crate through shared mechanics
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-crate-publish
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          release-config: ${{ github.workspace }}/.github/release-policy.json
          package: podman-lens
          validation-sha: ${{ needs.shared-release-gate.outputs.candidate_sha }}
          validation-result: ${{ needs.shared-release-gate.result }}
          validation-only: ${{ inputs.validation_only }}
      - name: Publish immutable GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.metadata.outputs.tag }}
        run: gh release edit "${TAG}" --draft=false --latest
  shared-release-gate:
    name: Shared exact-candidate release gate
    needs: [deterministic, release-metadata, native-conformance, semver, release-gate]
    if: always()
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-release-validation.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      config_path: .github/release-policy.json
      needs_json: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
  release-preparation:
    name: Read-only exact-candidate publication inventory
    needs: shared-release-gate
    if: >-
      github.repository == 'Strukturpiloten/podman-lens' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) &&
      needs.shared-release-gate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.shared-release-gate.outputs.candidate_sha == github.sha
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact release candidate and policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          policy-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          config-path: .github/release-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Validate common inventory without publication credentials
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-crate-publish
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          release-config: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          package: podman-lens
          validation-sha: ${{ needs.shared-release-gate.outputs.candidate_sha }}
          validation-result: ${{ needs.shared-release-gate.result }}
          validation-only: "true"
